answer: No, you don't need a paper lien release. Texas uses electronic titles, so your lender releases the lien to the state electronically, and we transfer the title electronically at your appointment. There's no paper title to bring. If the lien still hasn't been released, ask your lender to send the release. If that doesn't work, you can sign our lien release request, form NW-LRL-1, and we'll contact the lender for you, which can add 1 to 2 weeks. You can still get an offer and book your appointment while you wait.
